Playback

Blend songs together
Fades the end of each song into the start of the next. When it's off, songs play back to back with no gap.
Blend length 4s
How long the blend lasts.
Even out volume
Keeps loudness steady from song to song, so a quiet song doesn't dip after a loud one. Plays everything a touch lower overall to leave room for quieter songs.
Skip ads automatically
Podcast episodes and long YouTube audio: ad reads, sponsor plugs, reminders, intros and outros are skipped as they begin, with a note and Undo. Ads are found from the episode's captions, so it is a good guess, not a promise: when it skips something real, tap Undo. Off, you get a Skip button instead.
Skip talking in songs
Shows a Skip button when a song's video has talking before or after the music. Podcasts from YouTube always get one for sponsor reads and intros. Skip times from SponsorBlock, marked by its users.

Privacy & data

Personalized listening
EBBLESS uses what you play, finish, skip and like to shape Discover and your picks. Turn it off and new plays stop teaching it anything and nothing is sent to the shared tag pool. What it already learned is kept but not used. It comes back if you turn this on again, or you can erase it with Reset below.
Reset listening profile
Erases what EBBLESS learned about your taste on this device: skips and finishes, genre links, thumbs-downs, and the recent-plays list that seeds your picks. Your playlists, liked songs and library stay. Your listening recap and play history are separate and stay too. Other devices keep their own taste data.

Keyboard shortcuts

Keyboard shortcuts ⌨
Every key EBBLESS listens for, from play / pause to visuals.
  • SpacePlay / pause
  • ← →Previous / next song (podcasts: back / forward 15s)
  • Shift+← →Back / forward 10s (podcasts: previous / next episode)
  • ← →With the video open: back / forward 5s
  • Shift+← →With the video open: restart the song / next song
  • HHome: back to the player
  • P or LLibrary
  • Shift+LPaste a link
  • QQueue
  • SSettings
  • FFullscreen
  • EscClose the video, leave fullscreen, close a playlist
  • ZArt (again to change style)
  • XVisualizer
  • CLyrics
  • VVideo
  • IVisualizer: hold pattern on / off
  • KShuffle
  • ORepeat
  • MMini player (desktop)

About

EBBLESS exists to make listening feel like listening again. We bring your music together, keep it moving, and make discovery feel effortless. No ads. No sign-up. Simple but layered. Music, visuals, nostalgia, curiosity, and the freedom to wander. We believe music should be something you flow through, not something trying to own you.

EBBLESS plays your playlist or album straight through, without the gaps. Paste a public playlist, album, or song link from Spotify, SoundCloud, or Apple Music and EBBLESS finds and plays each song, or paste a YouTube playlist or video link directly. Podcasts work too: paste a Spotify or Apple Podcasts show or episode link, or a podcast's RSS feed. Either way, playback threads through so the listening doesn't stop.

EBBLESS works to skip ads before your song starts.
